data.description:
## Context / Problem
The code-review `tests` overlay (blocking at 0.54) is selected only when a changed file matches `**/test_*.py`, `**/*_test.py`, `**/tests/**` (`src/rebar/llm/code_review/registry.py:295-311`, `glob_triggered_overlays`; routing `src/rebar/llm/code_review/criteria_routing.json` key `tests`). A change that adds product logic and touches no test file never runs the overlay unless the base reviewer recommends it, and the overlay's guard (vii) (`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-tests.md:73-75`) keeps a bare coverage-gap finding advisory. Five src-only changes merged on `LLM-Review +1` with zero test files (Gerrit 388, 1547, 1920, 1737, 1703); change 388 (`d9e0f0e733`, new `git_adapter.py`) later produced three bugs. Approved in the fortnight defect review (operator decision, 2026-08-21); the diff-coverage alternative was rejected because the project tests behaviour and contracts, not coverage percentage.

## Approach
Add a content trigger in `registry.content_triggered_overlays` (`src/rebar/llm/code_review/registry.py:413`): select `tests` when the diff adds a function/method definition or a new conditional branch under `src/**` and changes no file under `tests/**`. Narrow guard (vii) in `code-review-tests.md` so that a gap on *newly introduced* behaviour with a named violating input is eligible to block; a gap on pre-existing code stays advisory. Docs, config, and pure renames add no definitions and never trigger. Keep the Four-Criterion test unchanged.

## Scope
`src/rebar/llm/code_review/registry.py`, `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-tests.md`, `src/rebar/llm/code_review/criteria_routing.json` (trigger provenance only), `tests/unit/llm/code_review/test_content_triggers.py` (new), `tests/unit/test_prompt_index.py` (prompt-index drift gate).

## Testing
Happy path: a diff adding `def` under `src/` with no `tests/` change selects `tests`. Edge: a docs-only diff, a config diff, and a rename-only diff (`git diff -M`) do not select it; a diff adding a `def` plus a test file selects it by glob as today. Pinning: `tests/unit/llm/code_review/test_registry*.py`, the overlay routing parity test, and `scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py` pass unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The five cited src-only diff shapes select the `tests` overlay when replayed through `glob_triggered_overlays`+`content_triggered_overlays`; checked by a parametrised test over synthetic diffs with the same file/def shape.
- [ ] Docs-only, config-only and rename-only diffs do not select it; checked by the same test.
- [ ] Guard (vii) text distinguishes newly-introduced from pre-existing behaviour and the prompt-index drift gate passes; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_prompt_index.py`.
data.title: Content-trigger the code-review tests overlay on new src behaviour with no test change
